g.text: All W/L values are nominal micrometres. Every NMOS bulk = vss; every PMOS bulk = vdd (bulk wires omitted).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #63758b

g.text: Code 0 keeps all trim devices physically present. Sign + four magnitude bits select codes -15 through +15.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #63758b

g.text: Connectivity guide, not GDS or a performance claim. External 5 fF loads, ideal source drivers and controller are not drawn.
